mapper.select: SELECT assignment.id AS residency_id, assignment.student_id, assignment.room_id, assignment.bed_id, assignment.batch_id, assignment.team_id, assignment.source_selection_mode, assignment.assignment_method FROM room_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.student_id=#{studentId} AND assignment.assignment_status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE

SELECT assignment.id AS allocation_id, assignment.student_id, assignment.bed_id, bed.room_id, assignment.batch_id, assignment.team_id, assignment.assignment_method FROM bed_assignment assignment JOIN bed ON bed.id=assignment.bed_id WHERE assignment.student_id=#{studentId} AND assignment.assignment_status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY assignment.assigned_at DESC, assignment.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT bed.id AS bed_id, bed.room_id, bed.bed_code, bed.bed_type, bed.operational_status, room.room_number, room.gender_restriction, room.education_level_scope, room.resident_scope, room.operational_status AS room_status, floor.floor_number, building.id AS building_id, building.building_name FROM bed JOIN room ON room.id=bed.room_id JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.id=room.floor_id JOIN dormitory_building building ON building.id=floor.building_id WHERE bed.id=#{bedId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE room_assignment SET room_id=#{roomId}, bed_id=#{bedId}, source_selection_mode='DIRECT', assignment_method='MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT', assigned_by=#{operatorId}, bed_confirmed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{residencyId} AND assignment_status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE bed_assignment SET bed_id=#{bedId}, assignment_method='MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE student_id=#{studentId} AND assignment_status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_assignment_history (room_assignment_id, student_id, room_id, bed_id, event_type, operator_user_id, reason, previous_data, current_data, occurred_at) VALUES (#{residencyId}, #{studentId}, #{roomId}, #{bedId}, 'BED_CHANGED', #{operatorId}, #{reason}, CAST(#{previousJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{currentJson} AS JSON), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))
